basalt_guards_vanilla_first.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapMethod on BasaltColumnsFeature.canPlaceAt (static): vanilla's two-read test (isAirOrLavaOcean via @Shadow, block below not air and not in CANNOT_PLACE_ON, position restored) first; false -> false without the original (the HEAD structure guards only ever answer false); true -> the original unchanged. Run-time check once: every @MixinMerged method of another mod in the class must be a known guard (mixin, handler name in Forge's or NeoForge's merged form, descriptor, fingerprint of the handler in its mixin class file), else the switch steps aside. 1.21.1 known guards: L_Ender's Cataclysm 1.21.1-3.33 and YUNG's API 1.21.1-NeoForge-5.1.9
basalt_guards_vanilla_first.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixin carries our own two-read predicate built on vanilla's helper isAirOrLavaOcean and list CANNOT_PLACE_ON (helper bons.furious.patch.basalt_guards.BasaltGuards); the guard mods' handlers are only read and fingerprinted
